summary: ResponseFunctionToolCallOutputItem.output (and ResponseCustomToolCallOutput.output) is typed string | Array<ResponseInputText | ResponseInputImage | ResponseInputFile> instead of string, so code that treats a function call output item's output as a plain string no longer type-checks
The Assistants API surface (client.beta.assistants create/retrieve/update/list/delete and the Assistant type) is marked @deprecated; it carried no deprecation before
The ComputerTool type now describes the GA computer tool (type 'computer'); the computer_use_preview tool it described before is renamed to ComputerUsePreviewTool
ResponseInputMessageItem.type ('message') is required instead of optional, so object literals of that type that omit it no longer type-check
The package's openai bin (the `openai migrate` codemod CLI from the v5 migration) is removed, so `npx openai migrate` no longer exists
The emitted(event) promise on the SDK's event streams and runners (ChatCompletionStream, runTools runners, AssistantStream) now rejects when an 'error' event fires instead of staying pending
Minimum supported Node.js rises from 20 to 22 (package.json engines >=22.0.0 added, Node version policy codified); Node 20 is no longer supported
embeddings.create called with encoding_format 'base64' now resolves to a response whose data[].embedding is typed string instead of number[] (a new overload); runtime behavior is unchanged
